_source.title: 筛选并获取日志条目
_source.remarks.text.0: 如果日志面板处于打开状态，筛选操作会同时在前端展现
_source.params.types: 日志类型数组，可以同时指定多种日志类型，如若不指定则为全部类型
_source.returns: 符合筛选条件的日志条目数组

title: Filter and get log entries
remarks.text.0: If the log panel is open, the filter operation will also be displayed on the front end
params.types: Array of log types. Multiple log types can be specified at the same time. If not specified, all types are used
returns: Array of log entries matching the filter criteria
